fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate found at any access: the north entrance drive off Calumet Ave (by the Starbucks outparcel, where an Averitt semi was turning in on 2024-06 Street View) is an open yellow-hatched drive; the inner court entries off the east-west access road show no barrier; the south Calumet drive is also open. Open-campus pattern.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any entrance in satellite or 2024-06 Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed on the plant's west face (~10), north court (~8), plus route-loading positions on the east building; ~20 trailers visibly docked, estimated ~30 doors across faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Distinctive silver Pepsi side-loader route trailers in herringbone rows: NW yard (~20), center-east yard (~15), plus a diagonal row staged along the rail corridor (~6).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW boundary with what may be an old spur alignment toward the plant's SW corner; no active spur into the property could be confirmed - set false, flagged.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The audited parcel is the Pepsi complex (main multi-section plant + east building + south warehouse). The large DC north of the access road and the flex/office buildings south of the south drive are separate properties and were excluded.
